import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    # Fix island column - strip whitespace
    df['island'] = df['island'].str.strip()
    
    # Fix species column - capitalize first letter
    df['species'] = df['species'].str.capitalize()
    
    # Convert text numbers to actual numbers
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(df['flipper_length_mm'], errors='coerce')
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(df['body_mass_g'], errors='coerce')
    df['year'] = pd.to_numeric(df['year'], errors='coerce')
    
    # Handle out_of_range body_mass_g - set to NaN if out of range
    df.loc[(df['body_mass_g'] < 2500) | (df['body_mass_g'] > 6500), 'body_mass_g'] = None
    
    return df

def answer(df):
    # Count penguins per island
    island_counts = df['island'].value_counts().to_dict()
    return island_counts
